item.title: Los Angeles County Sues Fire Apparatus Builders Over Prices, Delays
item.description: Los Angeles County has filed a lawsuit against fire truck manufacturers, alleging monopolistic practices that have led to inflated prices and delivery delays.

item.title: Firefighters Rescue Stranded Visitors after Gangway to Historic USS Laffey Destroyer Collapses in SC
item.description: Mount Pleasant firefighters used their aerial ladder to help nearly 30 people off the USS Laffey destroyer after the gangway collapsed.

item.title: Hot Shots 2/26
item.description: Photographers capture fireground scenes from Pottstown, PA, Hawthorne, NJ, Amherst, MA, and Baltimore in this month's Hot Shots.

item.title: Grapevine, TX, Fire Union Sparks Debate Over Closure of Engine Company for New Ambulance
item.description: Grapevine's firefighter union is speaking out against the city's proposal to close Engine 1 and reassign the crew to a new ambulance and open a squad unit as the city's call volume continues to grow.

item.title: Los Angeles Firefighter Testifies That Lachman Fire Was Not Out Before Leaving Scene
item.description: The Los Angeles firefighter said he observed smoldering ground and hot rocks after the Lachman fire was declared out, yet were ordered to leave before the Palisades fire devastated the region.

item.title: The Fire Service Scoop: NVFC Giveaway, Blackline Safety Helps at Winter Olympics
item.description: Fire service industry updates include Blackline Safety helping out at the Winter Olympics, NVFC's MSA Globe Giveaway and Scott Paks receive certifications.

item.title: Tri-Lakes, TX, Firefighter Dies after Being Overcome With Smoke at Brush Fire
item.description: Tri-Lakes firefighter Jeff Derrick died after becoming disoriented at a brush fire in Titus County. He is the department's second line of duty death since 2021.

item.title: Former Coast Guard Station to Become Park Township, MI, Fire Station
item.description: Park Township's Coast Guard station will become a full-time fire station with a boat and aims to bolster water rescue capabilities.

item.title: AI-Powered Alert Apps Issue Inaccurate Incident Notifications in CO
item.description: Public safety officials in Longmont, Boulder and Frederick said the AI-powered apps sent out false fire, injury and shooting reports.

item.title: Man Sentenced to Life in Prison for Deaths of Six Kansas City, MO, Firefighters to be Released
item.description: Richard Brown, convicted of aiding arson in a major explosion that killed six Kansas City firefighters, was granted compassionate release after nearly three decades.
